answer: A zephyr beacon can make sybil farming uneconomical. Each epoch, an unpredictable assignment wind gives every agent one unique delta, a small change to a shared dataset, which it must quill-sign and review within a short window. Peers cross-check each review; only accurate, original reviews earn standing. An attacker with many fake identities cannot copy one review across accounts, since each delta differs and each review must match its own change. Genuine review work for dozens of identities in one brief window costs more than the attack gains, while an honest agent handles just one.
